key_issues_to_review.issue_content: The except clause catches Exception and swallows the traceback, hiding real bugs and complicating debugging. Consider narrower exception types and log with exc_info.
The `payload` dict from request.json() is dereferenced without checking required fields — a malformed request will raise KeyError as a 500 instead of a 400.
Using a mutable default argument (default=[]) for `permissions` will cause all instances to share the same list.
